frameworks: Cayman Islands Y5 Expectations (island geography focus)

objectives.description: Use maps, atlases, globes and digital mapping to locate countries and describe features studied
Use symbols and a key (including the use of Ordnance Survey maps) to build knowledge of the UK and wider world
Use a range of maps, atlases, globes and digital mapping confidently to plan routes and locate features at a variety of scales
Use four-figure grid references and understand latitude and longitude
Use six-figure grid references, and understand latitude, longitude, the Equator, hemispheres, the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn, the Arctic and Antarctic Circles and time zones
Describe the distribution of natural resources including energy, food, minerals and water
Explain how the uneven distribution of natural resources affects trade and quality of life between regions
Explain human impact on the environment, including climate change and its effect on small island nations such as the Cayman Islands
Describe how coral reefs and mangroves protect coastlines and support biodiversity
Evaluate the effectiveness of different strategies used to reduce human impact on the environment, including in small island nations
Locate the world's countries, focusing on the Caribbean, Europe and North/South America, and their environmental regions
Describe climate zones, biomes and vegetation belts, and understand key aspects of physical geography including hurricanes and volcanoes
Locate the world's countries, using maps to focus on Asia and Africa, and their environmental regions, key physical and human characteristics
Compare a region of the United Kingdom with a region in a country in Asia or Africa

strands.name: Rivers and the Water Cycle
strands.description: New for Y6: physical geography of rivers and the water cycle.

objectives.description: Describe the stages of the water cycle, including evaporation, condensation and precipitation
Describe the physical features of a river from source to mouth, and explain how rivers shape the landscape

strands.name: Economic Activity & Trade
strands.description: New for Y6: human geography — economic activity, land use and trade links.

objectives.description: Describe types of economic activity, including trade links and the distribution of natural resources, focusing on energy, food, minerals and water
Explain how land use changes as a settlement grows, and describe the key characteristics of settlement and land use
